To provide members of the public access to the meeting and an opportunity to comment
on items on and off the Agenda, the following opportunities have been established:

Public Comments

Please email all public comments to HPCRC-PublicComment@sgch.org and include the
following in the subject line of your email: the section (Public Comment, Consent
Calendar, Public Hearing, New Business) and Item Number you are commenting on. The
Clerk will read public comments into the record for up to three-minute limit. Words that
would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory language,
will not be read. All public comments shall be emailed by 5:00 p.m. on the meeting day.

Example: PUBLIC COMMENT: New Business Item A

Watch the Meeting Online

Live broadcast of this meeting is available using the following link:

Meeting Video – https://www.youtube.com/CityofSanGabriel

Spectrum cable: Live streaming on Channel 3, Public Access Channel.
 Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
www.sangabrielcity.com. Materials related to an item on this Agenda, submitted to the
Planning Commission after distribution of the Agenda packet, will be posted on the City
website.

Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202 of
the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.

Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of
the above Agenda items prior to the meeting, please contact the Community Development
Department at commdevinfo@sgch.org during regular office hours.

Any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
participate in a meeting should direct such a request to the Community Development
Department by emailing commdevinfo@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the meeting, if
possible.

 HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE COMMISSION (HPCRC)

  REGULAR MEETING

  AGENDA – DECEMBER 14, 2022

•  CALL TO ORDER

•  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

•  ROLL CALL – COMMISSION

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for members of the public to address the HPCRC on
  items of interest that are not on the agenda, but are within the subject matter
  jurisdiction of the HPCRC. Pursuant to the Brown Act, the HPCRC cannot answer
  any questions or take any action until such time as the matter may appear as an
  item on a future agenda.

2.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A. Minutes from the May 11, 2022 HPCRC meeting.

  B. Minutes from the September 14, 2022 HPCRC meeting.

3.  HISTORIC RESOURCES SURVEY UPDATE

  The consultant, Architectural Resources Group (ARG), will provide an update on
  the Historic Resources Survey Project.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the Historic Preservation and Cultural Resource
  Commission PROVIDE COMMENTS.

4.  PRESENTATION: LA LAGUNA DE SAN GABRIEL

  This item is to provide a presentation on the La Laguna de San Gabriel.

5.  CASE STUDY: THE COVINA BOWL

  City Architectural Historian to provide a visual tour of the Covina Bowl (1956), the
  first, and one of the most lavish, Googie style bowling centers ever created, now
  re-stored and rehabilitated as part of a new housing development.

 HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE COMMISSION  3
 REGULAR MEETING – DECEMBER 14, 2022
 6.  CERTIFIED LOCAL GOVERNMENT (CLG) APPLICATION UPDATE AND
  PROPOSED ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT FOR CLEANUP ITEMS TO THE
  HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE ORDINANCE

  The City’s Architectural Historian will provide an update regarding the Certified
  Local Government (CLG) application and proposed Zone Text Amendment for
  cleanup items to the Historic Preservation and Cultural Resource Ordinance.

7.  STAFF ITEMS

  Staff may address the Commission on matters of general information and/or
  concern.

8.  COMMISSIONER COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Each Commissioner may address the HPCRC on matters of general information
  and/or concern. This is also the time for Commissioners to report on conferences
  and/or meetings they have attended.

9.  ADJOURN HISTORIC PRESERVATION  AND  CULTURAL  RESOURCE
  COMMISSION MEETING

  TO THE NEXT MEETING OF THE HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL
  RESOURCE COMMISSION ON MARCH 15, 2023 AT CITY HALL, 425 SOUTH
  MISSION DRIVE, 2ND FLOOR, COUNCIL CHAMBERS.

 HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE COMMISSION  4
 REGULAR MEETING – DECEMBER 14, 2022
   MINUTES OF THE MAY 11, 2022
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL
  HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Lubisich called the special meeting of the San Gabriel Design Historic Preservation and
Cultural Resource Commission (HPCR) to order at 6:31 P.M. on Wednesday, May 11, 2022, with
Commission members and staff present.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Weeks.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present:  Chair Senya Lubisich, Vice-Chair Beatriz Mojarro, Eric
  Urena, Kyle DeVriendt, Eric Weeks

Commission Members Absent:  None.

Staff Members Present:  Planning Manager Samantha Tewasart and Historic
  Preservation and Cultural Resource Commission
  Secretary Erika Ortiz.

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT- None

2.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES-

  Minutes from the February 16, 2022 HPCRC meeting.

  Commissioner Urena moved to approve the minutes from the February 16, 2022, HPCRC
  meeting. Commissioner Weeks seconded the motion. Motion passed by a vote of 5 ayes,
  and 0 noes.

3.  MILLS ACT

  This item was presented by Planning Manager, Samantha Tewasart.
   Chair Lubisich opened the public hearing.

  There being no speaker, Chair Lubisich closed the public hearing at 7:05 PM.

  The Commissioners provided comments on the overall application process and the fees
  attached to applying for the Mills Act.

4.  BELL AWARDS AND MARTIN E. WEIL AWARDS

  This item was presented by Planning Manager Samantha Tewasart.

  Chair Lubisich opened the public hearing.

  There being no speaker, Chair Lubisich closed the public hearing at 7:18 PM.

  The Commissioners provided remarks on how they look forward to having the Bell and
  Martin E. Weil Awards again.

5.  STAFF ITEMS

  Chair Lubisich asked for an update on the Certified Local Government (CLG) and proposed
  zone text amendment.

6.  COMMISIONER COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Vice-Chair Mojarro commented on the work done for the Land Acknowledgement
  Statement.

  Chair Lubisich mentioned events hosted by the California Historical Society.

7.  ADJOURN HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE COMMISSION MEETING

  To the next meeting of the Historic Preservation and Cultural Resource Commission on
  June 8, 2022, at City Hall, 425 S. Mission Dr., 2nd floor, council chambers.

  Chair Lubisich adjourned the meeting at 8:18 P.M.

   MINUTES OF THE SEPTEMBER 14, 2022
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL
  HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Lubisich called the regular meeting of the San Gabriel Design Historic Preservation and
Cultural Resource Commission to order at 6:30 P.M. on Wednesday, September 14, 2022, with
Commission members and staff present.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner DeVriendt

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present:  Chair Senya Lubisich, Vice-Chair Beatriz Mojarro, Eric
  Urena, Kyle DeVriendt

Commission Members Absent:  Eric Weeks

Staff Members Present:  Planning Manager Samantha Tewasart and Associate
  Planner Anthony Alvarado

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT- None

2.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES- None

3.  REVIEW OF LAND ACKNOWLEDGEMENT STATEMENT

  This item was presented by Community Services Manager, Matthew Morales-Stevens.

  Chair Lubisich opened the public hearing.

  There being no speaker, Chair Lubisich closed the public hearing.

  A motion was made by Commissioner DeVriendt, seconded by Commissioner Urena, to
  approve Consent Calendar Item 3 for a more condensed version of the proposed Land
  Acknowledgement Statement.
   Motion approved Consent Calendar Item 3 as presented, by a vote of 4-0 as follows:

  AYES: LUBISICH, MOJARRO, URENA, DEVRIENDT
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  WEEKS

4.  Street Name Change Guidelines

  This item was presented by Community Development Director Aldo Cervantes.

  Chair Lubisich opened the public hearing.

  There being no speaker, Chair Lubisich closed the public hearing at 7:08 PM.

  The Commissioners provided comments on the draft guidelines to be forwarded to the
  City Council, Planning and HEAR Commission.

5.  HISTORIC RESOURCES SURVEY UPDATE

  This item was presented by Project Manager Andrew Goodrich of the Architectural
  Resources Group (ARG).

  Chair Lubisich opened the public hearing.

  There being no speaker, Chair Lubisich closed the public hearing at 7:33 PM.

  The Commissioners provided comments on the progress provided by ARG.

6.  607 WEST ROSES ROAD PRESENTATION

  This item was presented by Associate Planner Anthony Alvarado. His presentation was
  followed by Phil Jameson, Board Member of the San Gabriel Cemetery.

  Chair Lubisich opened the public hearing.

  There being no speaker, Chair Lubisich closed the public hearing at 7:59 PM.

  The Commissioners provided comments on the proposed project on 607 W. Roses Rd.
  presentation.

 DESIGN REVIEW COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING – SEPTEMBER 14, 2022  2
 7.  CERTIFIED LOCAL GOVERNMENT (CLG) APPLICATION UPDATE AND PROPOSED ZONE
  TEXT AMENDMENT FOR CLEANUP ITEMS TO THE HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND
  CULTURAL RESOURCE ORDINANCE

  Ms. Jennifer Mermilliod, City Architectural Historian consultant provided an update
  regarding the Certified Local Government (CLG) application and proposed Zone Text
  Amendment for cleanup items to the Historic Preservation and Cultural Resource
  Ordinance.

  Chair Lubisich opened the public hearing.

  There being no speaker, Chair Lubisich closed the public hearing at 8:09 PM.

8.  STAFF ITEMS

  Ms. Jennifer Mermillion, City Architectural Historian consultant provided an update
  regarding the Mission Playhouse painting project.

9.  COMMISSIONER COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Chair Lubisich recognized the City of San Gabriel’s award from the LA Conservancy for its
  work on the Historical Context statement. Chair Lubisich also inquired on the city
  property between Pear St. and Mission Rd.

10.  ADJOURN HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL RESOURCE COMMISSION MEETING

  To the next meeting of the Historic Preservation and Cultural Resource Commission on
  December 14, 2022, at City Hall, 425 S. Mission Dr., 2nd floor, council chambers.

  Chair Lubisich adjourned the meeting at 8:18 P.M.

  ________________________________________
  ANTHONY ALVARADO, Associate Planner
